Warm-Up Bench ALGEBRA 1 · STAAR RELEASED, BY TEKS
Practice = short, focused skill reps from randomized generators. STAAR Released = verbatim questions pulled straight from real, TEA-released STAAR tests, with griddable items and A–D / F–J answer lettering.
Each row is a set of questions from one skill. Add rows to spiral several TEKS into one warm-up, or use a single row for a focused set. (R) = readiness, (S) = supporting. All 49 Algebra I TEKS are available in Practice mode; STAAR Released mode is limited to TEKS with a released-item bank (see note below the row if none exist yet).
TEKS selections here are for your planning only — the printed worksheet and answer key don't display any standard codes unless you turn on the code toggle above. TEKS follow 19 TAC §111.39; readiness/supporting labels follow the current STAAR Algebra I blueprint.
